the nuclear many-body problem cannot be solved in the framework of a perturbative approach.
the nuclear MBPT is not useful for nuclear structure calculations, and that the unitary transformation approach is more reliable.
the MBPT expansion is not useful for the calculation of nuclear interactions and that it can be replaced by the No Core Shell Model.

the application of many-body perturbations theory to nuclear-structure problems.

the usefulness of the nuclear MBPT for the calculation of the nuclear effective interaction is severely challenged and limited by the problems and difficulties of this approach.
